subject: QuantumLytics billing: PO metadata, net terms & invoice cadence
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@quantumlytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Initial procurement details: PO fields & billing cadence

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the model latency numbers look promising. Procurement asked me to confirm a few things before issuing a formal PO:

- Required PO fields: buyer entity name, PO number, cost center, GL code, billing contact email.
- We need invoices monthly, sent to procurement@quantumlytics.com, with a 45-day net payment term.
- They prefer one consolidated invoice per month (no weekly sub-invoices).
- Any discount or committed-rate needs to be explicit on the PO line items to flow to our AP system.

Can Redwood accept an invoice cadence of monthly-in-arrears and net45? Also, is there any metadata you require on the PO to map to a deal in your billing system (e.g., Redwood account ID, subscription SKU)?

I can attach a draft PO once we confirm these items.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Procurement
QuantumLytics

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@quantumlytics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial procurement details: PO fields & billing cadence

Alex —

Appreciate the clarity. Short answers up front: yes, we can support monthly invoices in arrears and net45. A couple of caveats and asks so AP can ingest cleanly:

- Required PO metadata: Redwood account ID (we'll provide), deal id (your internal PO -> please include QL-2026-0032), SKU lines (model serving credits vs. dedicated capacity), and billing contact email.
- If you want the discount to apply automatically, the PO should include the discount code/line and reference: "Redwood Discount: QL-ENT-15" (we'll confirm code).
- For consolidated monthly invoices we can do a single monthly invoice per legal entity; if you need per-cost-center breakdown we can add invoice line grouping but that may increase processing time (we can automate tags if you include cost center in each line).

I'm looping in Vanessa (billing ops) to confirm the exact PO field names and to provide the account ID to include on the PO. Once we have the draft PO we'll do a quick mapping to confirm there are no missing fields.

Next step: Alex, please attach the draft PO and indicate whether the discount you're expecting is a pre-negotiated committed discount or contingent on commit. If we confirm committed spend, we can lock the 15% slab; otherwise we may need to do a conditional credit.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@quantumlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial procurement details: PO fields & billing cadence

Alex, Ben —

Thanks — quick operational notes from billing:

- Redwood Account ID for QuantumLytics: RDW-QL-78
- Preferred PO fields (exact names to avoid ERP rejections):
  - buyer_entity_name
  - po_number
  - cost_center_code
  - gl_account
  - billing_contact_email
  - invoice_frequency = MONTHLY
  - invoice_format = PDF

- If your AP system requires "invoice to be labelled: Consolidated Mthly Invoice", please include that exact phrase in the PO's instructions field.
- For discounts: we can accept a PO with an explicit line item for a discount (negative line) OR a PO note referencing discount code. Negative-line is preferred for automated processing.

I'm attaching a short PO-field mapping template (attachment: po-field-mapping.xlsx) — please slot your draft PO values and re-send. We'll validate in our billing sandbox and confirm there are no missing fields.

Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@quantumlytics.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial procurement details: PO fields & billing cadence

Looping in legal / approvals context. Alex —

We are fine to accept net45 on a one-time basis for QuantumLytics provided:

1) The PO explicitly references deal id QL-2026-0032 and Redwood account RDW-QL-78.
2) The PO must include one of: a) a negative discount line for the 15% committed discount, or b) an explicit discount code field. Negative line preferred.
3) Payment terms: Net45 will be flagged in our AR system; for recurrent renewals we will revert to standard net30 unless we have a signed committed spend addendum.
4) Redwood requires a billing contact and an AP email for remittances.

If those items are on the PO we can approve the invoice cadence and discount application. If QuantumLytics prefers a per-cost-center breakdown on invoices we will provision those as separate invoice line groupings (additional setup lead time: 2 weeks).

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations (covers legal coordination)
Redwood Inference

From: QuantumLytics Procurement <procurement@quantumlytics.com>

Subject: Re: Initial procurement details: PO fields & billing cadence

Hi Ben / Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick responses — please find the draft PO attached (PO_QL-0032.pdf) and the SOW (QuantumLytics_SOW_v1.docx). Key items:

- We included the buyer_entity_name and po_number fields and put cost_center_code on each line.
- Invoice instructions include the exact phrase: "Consolidated Mthly Invoice".
- We added a negative discount line referencing "QL-ENT-15".
- Requested payment terms: Net45 and monthly-in-arrears billing.

Can you confirm receipt and indicate whether you need anything else to process the first invoice? We aim to have the PO countersigned by Friday EOD.

—Alex Rivera
Head of Procurement
QuantumLytics
